title: AI governance shared definitions
$comment: Definitions shared by the AI registry schemas in this directory. ADR-0006 §2.2 makes JSON Schema the schema authority across REST, events and gRPC; these files are the canonical form of the ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §3/§7 registry objects, and both halves of the Go/Python boundary are tested against them (backend/internal/adapter/gateway/schema_vocabulary_test.go, intelligence/tests/test_ai_schemas.py).

identifier.description: A stable, opaque registry identifier. Never reused once retired, for the reason ADR-0012 §2.9 gives for identifiers generally: historical evidence still names it.

owner.description: The named team or individual accountable for the object. AIGOV-001 §3 and §10 make an unowned registry entry a defect: the first question an incident asks is who owns it.

version.description: The version of this registry entry. A semantic version; 'latest' and other floating aliases are deliberately not expressible (AIGOV-001 §12).

region.description: A regional cell identifier (ADR-0006 §2.8). Residency is per cell and does not follow the model.

regions.description: A residency allowlist. Empty means no region is permitted, which is the correct default: an object that has not declared where it may run has not been through residency review.

privacyClass.description: A ZTAX-PRIV-001 §4 privacy class. Must equal the classes in contracts/privacy/vocabulary.json; the Python schema test asserts it.

positiveIntegerOrNull.description: A hard cap. null means the cap is not declared, which is distinct from zero.
